messages.subject: Discard bad chain
parts: Sometimes when I fit a complicated Stan model one of the chains will get stuck and not go anywhere. How can I discard this chain from my model fit?

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Discard bad chain
parts:
You don’t want to discard!  You want to figure out what’s going on.  It is possible that the process is not adapting well from a faraway starting point.  So you could try running Stan, specifying inits to reasonable values.
A
